changes.summary: Reduced from 998 to 738 lines. Manifest parsing/validation (_load_manifest, _validate_manifest, _load_optional_json, _check_dependencies, get_manifest_max_concurrent_workers) extracted to new app/tts_server/plugin_manifest.py. Instantiation/registry surface (LoadedPlugin, PluginLoadError, _load_plugin, _load_pip_plugin, _import_engine_class, _validate_engine_signatures, get_plugin_dir, _register_sdk_alias, discover_plugins) stays. Behavior-preserving; _register_sdk_alias's import-order guarantee and lazy importlib.metadata imports preserved in place.
New module, ~300 lines, owns manifest load/validate/dependency-check/concurrency-limit surface. Split out of plugin_loader.py following the plugin_staging.py precedent (one file per pipeline stage).
Characterization tests capturing plugin_loader.py/plugin_manifest.py behavior before/after the split (import ordering, discover_plugins/_load_plugin/_validate_manifest/_import_engine_class outputs).
